name: Design List
description: Design Collection family of eleven data-driven lists (avatar rows, files, checklist, leaderboard, contacts, settings, notifications, inbox, metric rows, compact, pills). Follows the native Universal Theme Content Row and Media List pattern: one query row per list row, with avatar or icon, title, subtitle, meta text and an optional link.
helpText: Each query row is one list row. Pick a Style for the whole region, then map Title (required) and the columns the style uses: Subtitle, Meta, Image URL or Initials (avatar), Icon, Value and Maximum (bars in leaderboard and metricRows), State and State Label, Link URL. Format numbers and dates in SQL.

attributes.name: Style
attributes.helpText: Design of the list. avatarRows: people rows with avatar and meta. fileRows: documents with a file-type tile. checklist: tasks with a check box and a Done or Open label. leaderboard: ranked rows with rank number and score bar. contacts: grid of people with presence. settings: grouped inset rows with icon tiles, value and chevron. notifications: tinted rows with state icon. inbox: message rows with sender, preview and time. metricRows: label, value and bar. compact: dense single-line rows. pills: wrapping chips.

attributes.name: Title
attributes.helpText: Main text of the row, for example a customer name, a file name or a task.

attributes.name: Subtitle
attributes.helpText: Secondary text, for example a role, file size or message preview. The Inbox style shows it on one line.

attributes.name: Meta
attributes.helpText: Short text at the end of the row, already formatted in SQL: a time, an amount, a score or a count.

attributes.name: Image URL
attributes.helpText: Avatar image URL. Must be developer-controlled, for example a URL built with apex_util.get_blob_file_src. Takes precedence over Initials and Icon.

attributes.name: Initials
attributes.helpText: One or two letters shown in the avatar circle when there is no Image URL, for example MC.

attributes.name: Icon
attributes.helpText: Font APEX icon class shown when there is no Image URL or Initials, for example fa-file-pdf-o or fa-bell.

attributes.name: Value
attributes.helpText: Plain number, without formatting, drawn as a bar in the Leaderboard and Metric rows styles, for example 72. Show the formatted value with Meta.

attributes.name: Maximum
attributes.helpText: Plain number for a full bar. Defaults to 100. For a leaderboard return the top score, for example max score over the whole query.

attributes.name: State
attributes.helpText: One of success, warning, danger, info or neutral; colors the status dot, icon tile or bar and is also given as text. In the Checklist style return done for a completed task (success also counts as done) and anything else for an open task. Unknown values render as neutral.

attributes.name: State Label
attributes.helpText: Visible text for the state, for example Online, Overdue, Unread or Shared. Without it, screen readers get a generic word for the state, and the Checklist style shows Done or Open.

attributes.name: Link URL
attributes.helpText: Optional target for the whole row, for example apex_page.get_url(p_page => 10, p_items => 'P10_ID', p_values => id). Must be developer-controlled. The Title becomes the link text.
